name: GLOVE BOX WITH GAS PURIFICATION SYSTEM
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Glove Box With Gas Purification System represents the pinnacle of controlled atmosphere technology. Designed for highly sensitive battery manufacturing (Li-ion), OLED development, and nuclear research, this hermetically sealed unit integrates a closed-loop gas recirculation system with a BASF copper catalyst. Operated via an advanced SIEMENS color touch-screen PLC, it effectively maintains moisture and oxygen levels below 1 ppm, safeguarding the absolute integrity of your reactive experiments.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS GLOVE BOX WITH GAS PURIFICATION SYSTEM is a hermetically sealed controlled-atmosphere workstation engineered for ultra-low moisture and oxygen environments (≤1 ppm) critical to air-sensitive research and manufacturing. Its closed-loop gas recirculation system forces the internal atmosphere through a purification column packed with BASF copper catalyst and UOP molecular sieves, which chemically scavenge oxygen and physically adsorb water vapor, while HEPA filters remove particulates >0.3 µm. This enables PhD researchers and chemists to safely handle pyrophoric organometallic reagents such as n-butyllithium, Grignard reagents, and transition-metal catalysts; assemble lithium-ion battery electrodes with lithium metal and LiPF6-based electrolytes in anhydrous carbonate solvents; and process OLED or perovskite precursor inks. B.Sc/M.Sc students use the system to learn air-free Schlenk techniques and anaerobic microbiology, while clinical researchers and quality-control laboratories rely on it for ISO 14644-1 particulate cleanliness and ISO 10648-2 containment performance when testing moisture-sensitive pharmaceuticals, volatile organic solvents, and oxygen-sensitive biological assays.
sop: Ensure the main power isolator and inert gas supply (argon or nitrogen) are connected and the gas pressure is within the recommended range.
Switch on the main power and allow the SIEMENS color touch-screen PLC HMI to initialize; log in with authorized credentials.
Verify that the oxygen and moisture analyzers display values below 1 ppm; if not, initiate a regeneration or purge cycle before use.
On the SIEMENS HMI PID controller screen, press the 'SET' button once.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., oxygen setpoint ≤ 1 ppm or chamber pressure).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Purge the antechamber: place items inside, close the outer door, evacuate and refill with inert gas at least three times before transferring into the main chamber.
Transfer items into the main chamber using the GUARDIAN butyl gloves, ensuring the HEPA filters are not blocked and the gloves are not overstretched.
Monitor the HMI continuously for O2, H2O, and pressure levels; confirm the blower and purification column are active during all operations.
After use, remove samples via the antechamber, close all valves, and set the system to standby mode following the shutdown sequence.

Safety Warning: Never open both antechamber doors simultaneously, and do not introduce volatile corrosive chemicals or free water into the chamber; always wear nitrile gloves under the butyl gloves to prevent contamination and glove damage.
features: Advanced closed-loop gas recirculation system maintaining O2 & H2O ≤ 1 ppm
High-efficiency purification column containing BASF copper catalyst & UOP molecular sieves
Integrated SIEMENS Color Touch Screen (PLC HMI) for seamless parameter control
Constructed from 3mm Stainless Steel 304 with an inclined 10mm tempered glass window
Equipped with premium GUARDIAN (USA) Butyl gloves with O-ring sealing
Fitted with Inlet & Outlet HEPA filters (>0.3µm) for particulate-free environments
